title: 让 Apple 项目配置和发布流程可持续复用
summary: 保留为 Apple 发布能力的唯一用户需求。现有 App Store Connect、Browser、Xcode、项目和设备资产盘点已完成；ContextProfile、项目绑定、签名、构建、上传、TestFlight 和发布编排仍待实现。当前阻塞于新的需求管理与运行时架构切换，切换前不执行旧任务树。
goals: Restore and verify current App Store Connect, Browser, Xcode, simulator, physical-device, and repository project bindings without storing secrets in repository state.
Add durable ContextProfile and ContextBinding records for Apple credentials, ASC apps, Browser profiles/domain grants, Xcode projects, devices, signing, and release targets.
Attach action-level ContextRequirements and produce bounded, provenance-rich, freshness-aware ContextResolutions/Capsules.
Complete typed Xcode capability, signing, archive, export, upload, processing, asset, TestFlight, metadata, and Apple Release Orchestrator workflows.
nonGoals: Do not create a generic Secret Manager in the first implementation; reuse existing plugin credential providers and store opaque profile references only.
Do not make App Store Connect context mandatory for simulator-only actions.
Do not use a broad taskType resolver when action-specific requirements are available.
Do not silently let explicit arguments override conflicting repository bindings for remote write or release actions.
Do not rely on CMP-20260723-0FFA4F as the sole source because its paused record is currently unreadable.
acceptanceCriteria: A new session can select an iOS repository and resolve the intended Team, bundle/app identity, project, scheme, device, Browser profile, and ASC app without retyping stable identifiers.

Claim kind, verification state, confidence, observed/verified timestamps, validity, provenance, and verification inputs are represented independently; desired intent is not conflated with observed state.
Conflicting high-risk Apple context stops remote write/release and produces an actionable explanation; low-risk simulator actions remain usable when ASC is absent.
Changing Xcode, project/bundle settings, credentials, bindings, or verification inputs invalidates only affected context; temporary device offline state does not erase durable identity.
No private keys, passwords, session cookies, or raw secrets enter Context Capsules, repository files, logs, or Completion Receipts.

Typed workflows cover capability inspection/apply, entitlements, signing, iCloud Containers, App Groups, certificates/profiles preflight, archive, export, upload, processing, assets, TestFlight, metadata/readiness, and final release orchestration with an explicit human authorization gate.
Real-repository E2E proves recovery, resolution, fail-closed conflicts, simulator independence, physical-device readiness, and an authorized release dry run or non-production equivalent.
relatedArtifacts: new requirement-management and SQLite architecture dependency

tasks.title: Add Apple ContextProfile and repository binding persistence
tasks.objective: Implement versioned durable profiles and bindings for credential provider reference, Team, ASC app, Browser profile/domain grants, Xcode project/scheme, bundle identity, device preference, and release target. Use atomic writes and preserve last-known-good records on failed updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Bindings use opaque credential/profile identifiers rather than secrets.
Repository-to-Team/app/project/browser mappings are explicit and inspectable.
Failed or partial writes do not replace known-good profiles.
Migration and deletion impact are previewable and audited.

tasks.title: Implement Browser named domain grants and profile bindings
tasks.objective: Replace brittle global allowlist replacement with additive/removable named Apple domain grants, deletion impact preview, and repository-to-browser-profile binding while preserving existing authorization gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding Apple access does not remove unrelated allowed domains.
Removing a grant shows affected repositories/profiles before apply.
Browser login-required, profile-unbound, domain-denied, and browser-unavailable states are distinct.
No browser cookie or password is persisted in repository state.

tasks.title: Implement monorepo iOS project discovery and project bindings
tasks.objective: Add bounded project_root, search_roots, max_depth, nested .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace discovery, ambiguity reporting, and durable repository project/scheme binding.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested iOS projects are discovered without unbounded scans.
Multiple plausible projects fail with actionable ambiguity rather than guessing.
A verified binding is reused across sessions and invalidated when project identity changes.
Non-iOS repositories remain cheap to inspect.

tasks.title: Attach action-level ContextRequirements and build the resolver/capsule
tasks.objective: Declare minimal context requirements per existing iOS, Browser, and ASC action; resolve fields from explicit inputs, repository bindings, plugin configuration, environment, and bounded observation with field/action/risk-specific precedence, conflict rules, freshness, provenance, and redaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Each action asks only for context it actually requires.
Remote writes and releases fail closed on binding/input conflicts.
Simulator actions do not require ASC credentials or a physical device.
Context Capsule is transient, bounded, redacted, and references durable Resolution/Profile records.
Resolution failure never overwrites known-good profile or binding state.

tasks.title: Integrate context verification with execution evidence and handoff
tasks.objective: Connect ContextResolution fingerprints and verification evidence to WorkContract, exact-revision checks, Completion Receipts, stale detection, work_get/work_inspect, and cross-session continuation without creating a new top-level facade.
acceptanceCriteria: Context changes invalidate only dependent evidence and actions.
A resumed session sees the resolved context fingerprint, stale reasons, and next safe verification step.
Remote effects cannot finalize without matching current context and execution evidence.
No material unbounded payload or default-path latency regression is introduced.

tasks.title: Deliver typed Xcode capabilities and signing workflows
tasks.objective: Implement or complete capability inspection, preview/apply, entitlements reconciliation, Team/bundle signing verification, iCloud Containers, App Groups, certificate/profile preflight, and safe rollback/repair semantics using resolved context.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutating capability action has preview, authorization classification, evidence, and post-apply verification.
Entitlements, project settings, Developer resources, and ASC state are reconciled rather than blindly overwritten.
Signing failures identify the missing or conflicting context without exposing secrets.
Focused fixtures and a real project validate no-op, apply, conflict, and rollback paths.

tasks.title: Deliver archive, upload, App Store assets, TestFlight, and metadata workflows
tasks.objective: Implement or complete archive, export, upload, processing wait, App Store asset management, build assignment, TestFlight, metadata/readiness, and submission preparation as typed resumable actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Each long-running stage is resumable and exposes bounded progress/evidence.
Build, version, app, Team, signing, and metadata identities are cross-checked before remote writes.
Uploads and metadata changes are idempotent or safely detect already-satisfied state.
Production submission remains separately gated.

tasks.title: Build and verify the Apple Release Orchestrator
tasks.objective: Compose context resolution, capabilities, signing, archive/export/upload, processing, assets, TestFlight, metadata/readiness, and final submission into a resumable orchestrator with explicit preflight, stop conditions, evidence, and human authorization for irreversible production actions.
acceptanceCriteria: The orchestrator never bypasses underlying typed actions or their authorization/resource claims.
A failed stage resumes without repeating completed irreversible effects.
A full non-production/dry-run E2E and an authorized production-path preflight pass.
Final handoff identifies exact app/version/build/revision/context and the one remaining human decision, if any.
All temporary branches/worktrees are merged and cleaned.
